content:
Leah: Quick Q — anyone leaving early Fri and want to do a grab-and-go brunch near the office? Flight at 9am so need something that survives a carry-on. Also suggestions for snacks to stash in the office fridge for late shifts?

Omar: For durable brunch: 'Daily Drip Deli' does sturdy egg sandwiches wrapped in foil. Reheat in toaster oven at the office.

Zoe: If you want bakery, 'Corner Crumb' has savory scones that travel well (and a GF banana loaf).

Ken: For carry-on snacks: jerky, nuts, and those oat bars that don't melt. Also, keep a few sealed single-serve peanut butter packs in the drawer 44d

Leah: Any vegan/soy-free recs for both brunch and fridge stash?

Omar: 'GreenBox' near the transit hub does hearty tofu breakfast bowls that can go cold or warm up. They pack them in leakproof containers.

Zoe: For fridge stash, hummus + pre-cut peppers and rice crackers. Label with name + date. Office rule: throw after 48h.

Ken: Nearby list (addresses):
```
Daily Drip Deli  120 Mission St
Corner Crumb Bakery  9th & Minna
GreenBox Kitchen  Transit Hub Market, 2nd floor
```

Leah: Awesome. Also, small office PSA: please don't use the communal Tupperware for personal overnight food anymore 622 leave a sticky note or use labelled containers.

Omar: Agree. If someone wants to donate snacks to the on-call shelf, put them in the clear tote and drop a note in #kitchen. 

lunchbot: Poll created "Fri early-flight brunch?" Options: 1) Daily Drip 2) Corner Crumb 3) No thanks. Vote with :one:/:two:/:three:.

Zoe: Voted :two: (I can bring napkins).

Ken: :one: for sturdy sandwich.

Leah: Thanks team! I'll grab 2 orders and bring extra crackers for the on-call shelf.
